newsitem.title: USA: Schering-Plough sees $810 mln R&D spending for '97.
newsitem.headline: Schering-Plough sees $810 mln R&D spending for '97.

text.p: Schering-Plough expects to commit about $810 million for research and development for 1997, said Richard Kogan, president and chief executive officer, at the company's annual meeting Tuesady.
Last year, Schering-Plough spent $723 million on research and development, a fourth of which was earmarked for biotechnology, Kogan said.
In other business, stockholders elected David Garfield, Robert Luciano, H. Barclay Morley, Carl Mundy Jr. and Patricia Russo for three-year terms as directors, the company said.
The stockholders also ratified the appointment of Deloitte & Touche LLP as auditors for 1997 and approved adoption of the company's stock incentive plan for 1997, it said.
